task: Scaffold-separated OCELOT wide-element 3D property training and calibration

protocol.geometry: Uniform ETKDGv3+UFF, original DFT geometry unavailable
protocol.selection: Prioritize B/Si/Se/As/Te within each fixed split, then deterministic hash order

checkpoint_metadata.uncertainty: Independent bootstrap adapter disagreement; calibration not implied

calibration.method: Held-out normalized-residual intervals; not a Gaussian standard deviation
calibration.limitations: Scaffold shift and QM9s OOD are not covered by exchangeability assumptions

applicability_domain.method: training-element coverage and maximum Morgan Tanimoto to the actual 8192 training structures

exact_input_coordinates.reason: bond_inference: Explicit valence for atom # 10 Si, 5, is greater than permitted

rounded_0.01A.reason: bond_inference: Explicit valence for atom # 10 Si, 5, is greater than permitted

coordinate_graph_recovery.scope: Known input geometries; rounded coordinates are a sensitivity test, not the full octree transform

limitations: Unequal rare-element subgroup sizes; n=1 is an individual error, not a general accuracy estimate
Geometry construction failures remain exclusions, including unsupported UFF Se types
Calibration does not establish OOD or quantum accuracy
Coordinate graph recovery can add previously unspecified stereo or change charge/bond assignments; exact identity and these cases are reported separately
